spawn_multi_process: spawn multiple processes on a single node to run a test method across ranks using torch.multiprocessing.spawn
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local single-rank distributed process group with a specified backend like nccl or gloo
ForkedPdb_set_trace: attach a debugger to a forked multiprocessing child process by calling ForkedPdb().set_trace() on a specific rank
PGConfig_dataclass: create a PGConfig dataclass to configure backend, world size, and gradient parallel group settings for distributed tests
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank environment then launch a test method in a spawned multiprocessing worker
